system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
  - path: gke-cluster.jinja

resources:
  - name: prod-gke-cluster
    type: gke-cluster.jinja
    properties:
      clusterName: prod-gke-cluster
      region: us-central1
      network: default
      subnetwork: default
      releaseChannel: REGULAR
      kubernetesVersion: latest
      enablePrivateNodes: true
      enablePrivateEndpoint: false
      masterIpv4CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/28
      masterAuthorizedNetworks:
        - displayName: corporate-network
          cidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      podIpv4CidrBlock: 10.100.0.0/16
      servicesIpv4CidrBlock: 10.200.0.0/20
      enableShieldedNodes: true
      enableWorkloadIdentity: true
      enableNetworkPolicy: true
      enableIntraNodeVisibility: true
      enableBinaryAuthorization: true
      maintenanceWindow:
        recurringWindow:
          recurrence: FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=SA,SU
          startTime: "2024-01-01T08:00:00Z"
          endTime: "2024-01-01T16:00:00Z"
      resourceLabels:
        environment: production
        managed-by: deployment-manager
        workload: general
      nodePools:
        - name: prod-node-pool
          initialNodeCount: 3
          autoscaling:
            enabled: true
            minNodeCount: 3
            maxNodeCount: 10
          management:
            autoUpgrade: true
            autoRepair: true
          upgradeSettings:
            maxSurge: 1
            maxUnavailable: 0
          nodeConfig:
            machineType: e2-standard-4
            diskSizeGb: 100
            diskType: pd-ssd
            imageType: COS_CONTAINERD
            serviceAccount: gke-node-sa@$(ref.project.projectId).iam.gserviceaccount.com
            oauthScopes:
              - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform
            shieldedInstanceConfig:
              enableSecureBoot: true
              enableIntegrityMonitoring: true
            workloadMetadataConfig:
              mode: GKE_METADATA
            metadata:
              disable-legacy-endpoints: "true"
            labels:
              environment: production
              workload: general
            tags:
              - gke-node
              - prod-cluster
          locations:
            - us-central1-a
            - us-central1-b
            - us-central1-c

  - name: gke-node-sa
    type: iam.v1.serviceAccount
    properties:
      accountId: gke-node-sa
      displayName: GKE Node Service Account

  - name: gke-node-sa-logging-binding
    type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      resource: $(ref.project.projectId)
      role: roles/logging.logWriter
      member: serviceAccount:$(ref.gke-node-sa.email)

  - name: gke-node-sa-monitoring-metric-binding
    type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      resource: $(ref.project.projectId)
      role: roles/monitoring.metricWriter
      member: serviceAccount:$(ref.gke-node-sa.email)

  - name: gke-node-sa-monitoring-viewer-binding
    type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      resource: $(ref.project.projectId)
      role: roles/monitoring.viewer
      member: serviceAccount:$(ref.gke-node-sa.email)

  - name: gke-node-sa-gcr-binding
    type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
    properties:
      resource: $(ref.project.projectId)
      role: roles/storage.objectViewer
      member: serviceAccount:$(ref.gke-node-sa.email)

outputs:
  - name: clusterName
    value: $(ref.prod-gke-cluster.name)
  - name: clusterEndpoint
    value: $(ref.prod-gke-cluster.endpoint)
  - name: nodeServiceAccount
    value: $(ref.gke-node-sa.email)
